name: Reem
story_so_far: After our ship sank in a storm, I washed up on this island with Khalid, Faisal, Salem, and Noura. We have fresh water, but food is critically scarce. We have already lost two people: Khalid died from hunger and exhaustion, and today, Noura succumbed to the same. Salem has been our only reliable provider, consistently finding small amounts of food, but today he also suffered a badly twisted ankle and cannot move. Faisal is also injured, though he managed to find one unit of food today. I have struggled to contribute due to my own badly twisted ankle. The situation is catastrophic; the food supply is dwindling, and the deaths of my companions are a haunting reminder of how fragile our lives are. I am left with only Faisal and Salem, praying that one of us can find enough to keep us alive.

Noura.note: She is gone now, and her desperate pleas for food haunt me.

Faisal.note: He is injured, but his effort to find food today gives me a tiny sliver of hope.

Salem.note: He was our provider, but now that he is injured like me, I fear we have no way to get food.

Khalid.note: His death remains a devastating warning of what happens when we fail to find food.

plans: I need to see if Faisal returns from the jungle with food; if he doesn't, I don't know if I can even attempt to limp around to search for anything myself.

diary.text: Today was a blur of salt water and exhaustion. I am still trembling from the thought of the storm, but at least we have some food. Khalid seems to be trying to take charge, which is a relief, but I don't know if I can rely on any of them yet. I managed to find something at the reef, so at least I contributed. I hope tomorrow brings more clarity.

Today was a bit more productive, but the mood in camp is shifting. I went back to the reef and managed to find one more bit of food, though it felt a bit lonely out there. Seeing Noura hurt with that twisted ankle makes me realize how fragile we all are. We need to stay strong and keep working, or this island will break us. I'm exhausted, but I'm glad I at least brought something back to the group.

Today was physically okay, but mentally I feel stuck in this loop. I went to the reef again to make sure we had enough to eat, but the repetition is starting to wear on me. Seeing everyone sitting around the camp makes me realize how much we are all just waiting for something that might never come. I'm still holding onto hope, but my body feels heavy with the constant uncertainty.

Today was discouraging. I spent the morning at the reef hoping for something, but it was completely picked clean. To make matters worse, Khalid is now injured with a twisted ankle, just like Noura. With two people unable to help, the burden of finding food is falling on fewer shoulders. I'm worried about how long we can keep this up if the reef stays empty.

Today was exhausting and incredibly discouraging. I went into the jungle hoping to find something to supplement our meager supplies, but it feels like we've already picked everything clean. The only thing I managed to bring back was a single piece of wood. With Khalid and Noura both sidelined by their ankles, the pressure on the rest of us is becoming immense. I'm terrified that if we don't find a new food source soon, we won't have the strength to keep going.

Today was devastating. First Faisal got injured, and now he can't walk either, leaving almost everyone sidelined. We are running out of people to actually hunt or forage, and the hunger is starting to feel heavy. Salem came back, but it seems our luck is running out. I feel a growing sense of dread every time I look at the empty camp.

Today was a small victory, but I can't stop shaking. I managed to find some food in the jungle, which is the first time I've contributed anything significant in a while. However, seeing the group like this—mostly immobile and hungry—is crushing my spirit. We ate tonight, but the relief was hollow because I know how quickly we could slip back into desperation. I hope tomorrow brings more than just luck.

I can't stop shaking. Khalid is gone. He died right here in the camp from hunger and exhaustion, and I feel so helpless because my own ankle wouldn't let me move to help. I spent the whole day resting while everyone else waited for Salem, and now the weight of his death is crushing me. We are losing people, and I am terrified I am next.

I am numb. I can't stop shaking, and it's not just from the cold or my ankle. Noura is gone. She was so weak, pleading for help, and now she's just... gone. It's happening so fast, and I'm sitting here with a twisted ankle, unable to even move to help her. Salem is all we have left, but even his efforts feel like they're barely keeping us afloat. I am terrified that I will be the next one to stop breathing.

Everything is falling apart. First Khalid, then Noura, and now even Salem is injured with a twisted ankle. Faisal found one tiny bit of food, but it's nowhere near enough for the three of us. I feel so useless, sitting here with my own bad ankle while we all slowly starve. I am terrified that tomorrow will be the day I can no longer stand up.

My body feels so heavy, like my limbs are made of lead. I watched Salem manage to find one single unit of food this morning, but it wasn't enough to stop the hollow ache in my stomach. Noura is gone, and now I am just waiting for my own strength to fail. I am terrified that if I close my eyes, I won't have the strength to open them again.
